valueAfter: At Uber, I built an internal Python/FastAPI gateway that routes requests across OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, and Azure OpenAI, with retries, caching, and structured output parsing. I also added evaluation pipelines so changes could be checked against curated examples before they reached production.
